entries.subject: Placement
entries.finding: Gaia DR3 source 6727439895482929536: position at J2016.0. Distance: McDonald, Zijlstra & Watson (2017), MNRAS 471, 770, table 2, HIP 90037: distance 148.588 pc, the paper's parallax inverted (Gaia DR1's where it revised the star's, else the Hipparcos reduction of van Leeuwen 2007; section 2.3; fractional uncertainty 0.064), at which the luminosity and radius hold (https://doi.org/10.1093/mnras/stx1433): 148.588 +/- 9.51 pc; Gaia DR3 parallax 6.7176 +/- 0.1706 mas (same row, RUWE 0.87), 39.4 standard errors, is not used. Proper motion: Gaia DR3 (same row): -41.570, -29.379 mas/yr. Radial velocity from the same row.

entries.subject: Radius, mass and temperature
entries.finding: Radius 39.341 solar radii from McDonald, Zijlstra & Watson (2017), MNRAS 471, 770, table 2, HIP 90037: radius 39.341 solar radii, implied by the fitted luminosity 371.904 solar luminosities (fractional uncertainty 0.089) and temperature (https://doi.org/10.1093/mnras/stx1433). No mass is measured, so GM is 0, the records' unpublished value. Temperature 4044 +/- 125 K from McDonald, Zijlstra & Watson (2017), MNRAS 471, 770, table 2, HIP 90037: effective temperature 4044 +/- 125 K, from the fit of a model atmosphere to the star's spectral energy distribution (goodness of fit Q 0.041).
